_readme: The example recipe, and REAL INPUT rather than a fixture: assert-pack-roundtrip.mjs rebuilds
packages/core/test/fixtures/pack/v1/ from this file on every push and fails on any drift, and
packages/core/test/content_pack_fixture_test.dart loads that same committed pack through the REAL
ContentPackLoader. So every guard in the content_gate lane has a non-empty domain on a clean
checkout, before a single generated pack exists.
The content is hand-authored travel phrases — [ADR 019]'s 🟢 near-zero risk tier (short functional
phrases and facts are not copyrightable by anyone) — and hand-authored precisely so this repository
carries no model output it cannot account for. `generation-log.json` records that honestly rather
than claiming a model that never ran.
